answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the anchor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the echo of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
